# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Filtered rendering corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 incorporates image-sampling, filter-cache, and glyph-rendering fixes on the existing Skia m157 engine.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Preserve image subsets under antialiasing** — Image sampling respects subsets and logical texture bounds under minification, strong skew, AA clipping, and MSAA. Stricter sampling constraints prevent unrelated backing-store texels from leaking into filtered images when one-pixel padding cannot contain expanded texture coordinates. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Align filter-cache equality and hashing** — Image-filter cache keys use bytewise equality consistent with their hash, including signed-zero representations, cached matrix type metadata, and subnormal values whose numeric comparison can depend on floating-point mode. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Correct reloaded glyph masks and outlines** — Mask filtering rasterizes the reloaded glyph's own outline and clears incompatible mask formats rather than copying them. Clipped embossed masks retain full plane strides and clear all destination planes, preventing stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted mask output. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
